name: Match Home UI to Figma
description: Update the Home page sections (Hero, Founder, Our Process) to use the user-provided Figma images and adjust the Our Process layout so text stays left and cards shift right to match the Figma design.

goal.answer: Update the Home page sections (Hero, Founder, Our Process) to use the user-provided Figma images and adjust the Our Process layout so text stays left and cards shift right to match the Figma design.

criteria.answer:
HeroSection uses /assets/images/hero-bg.png from the provided Figma asset
FounderSection uses /assets/images/founder.jpg from the provided Figma asset
HowItWorksSection uses /assets/images/process-bg.jpg from the provided Figma asset
HowItWorksSection layout places text on the left and cards slightly to the right, matching the Figma proportions
No placeholder or TODO content remains in touched files
Dev server builds and the Home page renders without errors

constraints.answer: Use the exact user-provided image files; do not recreate or redesign content, Keep existing cards/content in Our Process; only resize/reposition, Do not add new dependencies

assumptions.answer: User-provided images are at C:\Users\User\Desktop\Projects\Lorenzo\Figma UI\Web Ui\Home\images inside component; The existing Home section files are HeroSection.tsx, FounderSection.tsx, and HowItWorksSection.tsx; Standard HTML tags are acceptable per the implementation guide
